description: This PHP source file defines a class ImportViewStep2, which handles the presentation of the second step in an import process within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for rendering a web interface, assigning data to templates, and embedding JavaScript for user interactions during the import step.

classes.name: ImportViewStep2
classes.description: Handles the user interface for step 2 of the import process, including setting up instructions, managing import mappings, and generating embedded JavaScript for UI interactions.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the import step 2 interface, assigning variables to templates, retrieving saved and published import mappings, and including necessary JavaScript.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Returns embedded JavaScript code used to manage user interactions in the import step 2 UI, such as navigation buttons, validation, and mapping publishing.
